name: [Portal] Medailonek edit screen (public fields, CZ/SK/HU text, logo)
description:
### Summary

This task delivers the medailonek editing screen in Shoptet's Partner Portal, the self-service application for agencies, freelancers, affiliate partners and addon developers. The medailonek is the partner's public profile card shown on partneri.shoptet.cz and doplnky.shoptet.cz; today a partner must e-mail Shoptet and staff edit WordPress by hand. The new page lets the partner edit public fields such as name, logo, website, contacts, social links, country, hourly rate and VAT flag, and write the descriptive text separately for Czech, Slovak and Hungarian in a Markdown editor with a rendered preview. Saving stores a draft, each language shows its current state, and the logo upload is validated on the server. The backend controller and the React page ship together. The screen depends on the partner profile domain layer, the restricted Markdown converter and the portal shell, all separate tasks. Deciding whether text is published immediately or after approval, and the approval mechanics themselves, belong to the publication flow task, not this one.

### Why?

The medailonek is the core partner self-service of the MVP. Today a partner e-mails Shoptet to change their public card on partneri.shoptet.cz or doplnky.shoptet.cz and someone edits WordPress by hand. This screen removes that manual step. It sits on the domain layer () and the restricted Markdown () and is the only pure portal screen in this block, so backend controller and React page ship together.

### What?

A Partner Portal page "Medailonek" where the partner edits public fields (name, logo, url, contact e-mail, phone, social links, country/region, hourly rate, VAT flag, categories) and per-language text for CZ/SK/HU in a Markdown editor with rendered preview. Saving stores a draft. A publish/submit action hands over to the publication flow (separate task under this epic); the screen shows the current state per language: draft, pending, approved, rejected. Logo upload with server-side validation.
